messages:
emily: CI started failing SAST artifact uploads ~11:02 UTC, scanner-agent shows KMS decrypt denied on evidence blobs.

jake: Seeing a burst of failures, logs show: 
```
ERROR AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt denied for projects/keystore/keys/artifact-key
scanner-agent: upload failed
```

lena: Did infra PR 4321 change keystore bindings? Anyone touch the key IAM?

marcus: I tightened the keystore binding last night to remove broad roles. I thought scanner SA still had explicit access but maybe I scoped it too narrowly. Starting a revert.

emily: Can we avoid a full revert immediately? Proposed runbook: (1) ephemeral kms:Decrypt grant for scanner SA, (2) re-run failing pipelines, (3) collect audit-log slice, (4) open follow-up to harden tests and policy.

sec-bot: Audit event: IAM binding change by infra-bot at 2026-03-23T03:58Z, commit sha abcdef1. Resource: projects/keystore/keys/artifact-key, role affected: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter.

sec-oncall: Taking lead. @marcus create revert PR but hold merge. I'll issue an ephemeral grant for 15 minutes to unblock CI and validate.

jake: Validation command I'm using: 
```
# impersonate scanner SA to test decrypt
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=prod --key=artifact-key --ciphertext=... --impersonate-service-account=scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

sec-bot: Ephemeral grant executed: /grant kms:Decrypt scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com duration=15m  audit_id=GNT-xyz987. CI notified. :white_check_mark:

emily: Re-ran the blocked SAST jobs  uploads resumed, artifacts streaming, no new failures. :tada:

marcus: Revert PR opened (4324). I'll keep it unmerged until CI is green and we capture full audit evidence. I'll add a follow-up to add a scanner-allowlist on the key and an infra test.

lena: Long-term fix: add a pre-merge check that runs a kms:Decrypt probe as the scanner SA against a non-prod fixture key so RBAC changes fail fast in CI. Also update rollout checklist to include keystore binding verification.

emily: Created ticket SEC-2026: preserve scanner access + add premerge kms test + update runbook. Assigned to marcus. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/SEC-2026

sec-oncall: Final status: CI green, re-runs succeeded, ephemeral grant expired after 15m, no further AccessDenied in logs. Closing incident but keeping SEC-2026 actions. Ping me if it reoccurs.

marcus: Thanks everyone  I'll follow up with PR improvements, add explicit audit alerts for unexpected keystore role removals, and wire the pre-merge probe into infra tests. :shipit:
